root_cause: The iGPU unit test suite (ov_gpu_unit_tests, 29201 total cases) was still only ~94% complete (27440/29201) roughly 80 minutes after the job started (14:02:23 start, cancelled at 15:22:24), at which point the workflow/job timeout cancelled the step mid-test-run with 'context canceled' / 'The operation was canceled.' No test assertion failure or crash is present in the log; the job simply ran out of allotted time. This is independent of the merged commit's content: #39638 adds a new parameterized 5D-range test case to quantize_gpu_test.cpp (a handful of new test cases), which is a negligible addition to total suite runtime and does not explain an 80-minute overall runtime on its own, though incremental growth of the GPU unit test suite over time (now 29201 cases) is a contributing structural factor.
reproduction_steps: Not reproducible as a deterministic failure; it is a duration/timeout issue. To investigate: run `ov_gpu_unit_tests` locally or in CI with `--gtest_list_tests`/timing instrumentation (e.g. via gtest_parallel.py, which this job already uses) to measure total wall-clock time on the iGPU runner hardware, and compare against the job/workflow timeout (approximately 80 minutes based on this run's start/cancel timestamps).
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Linux (Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.11)' workflow's iGPU Tests (unit) / GPU job; since this is a recurring timeout rather than a deterministic failure, a rerun may complete within the time limit if the runner is less contended.

Increase the iGPU unit tests job's `timeout-minutes` in job_gpu_tests.yml (or the relevant job definition) to accommodate the current ~29201-case suite size, or raise the gtest_parallel worker/shard count to reduce wall-clock time.
Split the GPU unit test suite into multiple parallel shards/jobs so no single job needs to run the full ~29201 cases sequentially within one timeout window.

Profile the slowest test suites (e.g., smoke_sdpa_gpu_test, smoke_sdpa_gpu_compressed_kv_per_channel, concat_gpu) to identify candidates for consolidation or runtime optimization, since SDPA-related parameterized cases dominate the tail of the run.
prevention_strategies: Track GPU unit test suite size and total wall-clock duration over time (e.g., via a CI timing dashboard) and proactively increase job timeout or add sharding before the suite organically grows past the current timeout headroom. Avoid adding large parameterized test matrices to already-long-running suites without re-evaluating the job's time budget.
historical_context: Identical signature (iGPU unit tests job exceeding an ~80-minute timeout and being cancelled mid-run) was first recorded on 2026-10-30 (run 41072340950, commit 4964038cf75b6b4273b2bc57a60e95f5f2995b26), indicating this is a recurring, suite-growth-driven timeout rather than a one-off infrastructure blip.
